about: Shared findClaude cases (Claude Code as a model server, D4). Run by test/claude-finder.test.ts against src/mesh-config.ts and by packages/mesh/test/claude-finder.test.ts against the package's copy. Each case builds files under a scratch folder: `files` maps a path relative to it to exec (a 0755 script), plain (a 0644 file), open (a 0775 script, writable by the group), dir (a folder) or link:<path> (a symlink to that path, relative to the scratch folder). `path` is PATH's entries, with $ standing for the scratch folder; `fixed` the fixed system candidates the same way; home is $/home. `expect` is the path findClaude returns (compared by real path), or null.

cases.name: the first PATH folder that holds it wins
a PATH folder without it is passed over
a relative PATH entry is never searched
a file the user may not execute is passed over
a folder named claude is passed over
the first one found decides: one others may write is refused, not passed over
a link is followed to its real file
a link to a file others may write is refused
the fixed system places come after PATH
a fixed system place is used when PATH has none
~/.local/bin comes before the other places in home
no PATH at all still looks in home
